conventions: Boundary views present controller results and errors to the actor.
Controls coordinate use cases; entities hold logical domain information.
BookCatalogue and ReservationSet denote collections of logical Book and Reservation records, not a database design.
A break fragment terminates the interaction when its guard is true.
Atomic-change frames impose the all-or-neither requirement; intermediate changes are not independently committed.
Each dynamic model corresponds to exactly one existing user-goal use case.

models.title: Illustrative BookBridge object snapshot
models.purpose: Static model with instances, slots and links

models.title: Maintain the book catalogue
models.purpose: Catalogue creation, editing and listing with staff access, validation and save failure.

models.title: Record stock receipts
models.purpose: Positive stock additions with staff checks and preservation on failure.

models.title: Browse and find books
models.purpose: Catalogue search and optional detail access, including empty and failure outcomes.

models.title: Create a reservation
models.purpose: Atomic creation and stock deduction, saved price, role checks and duplicate prevention.

models.title: Cancel an own pending reservation
models.purpose: Owner-only pending cancellation with atomic restoration and terminal-state refusal.

models.title: Confirm collection
models.purpose: Staff collection confirmation with details, status recheck and refusal of terminal records.

models.title: View own reservations
models.purpose: Customer-owned list/detail query with empty, denied and read-failure alternatives.

models.title: View and filter all reservations
models.purpose: Staff-wide status query with role checks, exact filter values and read-only outcomes.

models.title: Summarise completed reservations
models.purpose: Completed-only read and totals from saved values, including zero and read-failure results.
